Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying exemptions to the aircraft fuel tax.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the aircraft fuel tax; and amending RCW82.42.030.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 82.42.030 and 1989 c 193 s 4 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provision of RCW 82.42.020 imposing the payment of an excisetax on each gallon of aircraft fuel sold, delivered or used in thisstate shall not apply to aircraft fuel sold for export, nor to aircraftfuel used for the following purposes: (1) ((The operation of aircraftwhen such use is by any air carrier or supplemental air carrieroperating under a certificate of public convenience and necessity underthe provisions of the Federal Aviation Act of 1958, Public Law 85726,as amended; (2))) The operation of aircraft for testing or experimentalpurposes; (((3))) and (2) the operation of aircraft when such operationis for the training of crews in Washington state for purchasers ofaircraft who are certified air carriers((; and (4) the operation ofaircraft in the operations of a local service commuter)): PROVIDED,That the director's determination as to a particular activity for which p. 1 SB 6039aircraft fuel is used as being an exemption under this section, orotherwise, shall be final. To claim an exemption on account of sales by a licensed distributorof aircraft fuel for export, the purchaser shall obtain from theselling distributor, and such selling distributor must furnish thepurchaser, an invoice giving such details of the sale for export as thedirector may require, copies of which shall be furnished the departmentand the entity of the state or foreign jurisdiction of destinationwhich is charged by the laws of that state or foreign jurisdiction withthe control or monitoring or both, of the sales or movement of aircraftfuel in that state or foreign jurisdiction.
